payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones

condition.question: Is the original blue mug from the source visibly positioned to the right of the headphones, is there concrete visual evidence that this same mug moved toward the headphones but remains short of the right-side position, is there evidence it was not displaced toward them, or is its identity or displacement unresolved?
condition.criteria: Compare SOURCE and EDITED images, tracking the source light-blue mug by its shape, handle, appearance, and scene context. The endpoint is fully achieved only if that same mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones; a different mug on the right does not count. For incomplete fulfillment, require concrete visual evidence that the source mug itself was displaced toward the headphones and a visible remaining positional deficiency. Assess the blue blurred form’s shape and extent and its spatial location relative to the source mug’s former position, the headphones, and the candidate mugs, alongside any continuity cues. A changed position or form of the blue blur may support partial movement when those visible cues jointly distinguish displacement from an artifact, but blur, color, absence at the former position, or scene change alone is not proof of movement. Evidence of no progress requires evidence that the source mug was not displaced toward the headphones, not merely failure to identify it at the endpoint. If identity or displacement cannot be determined from visible form, spatial cues, and scene context, report insufficient evidence rather than inferring progress or no progress.
condition.binding: SOURCE: the single light-blue mug left of the black headphones. EDITED: a blue blurred form is near the mug’s former left-side location; a small white mug is immediately beside the headphones, and another white mug is to their right. Compare the blur’s visible form and spatial relation to the source mug’s former position, the headphones, and both candidate mugs, and assess any continuity cues. Do not identify either white mug as the source mug without visible continuity, and do not treat the blur or scene change alone as proof of displacement.
condition.source_quote: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
condition.aspect: Relative position and continuity of the source mug and headphones
condition.endpoint: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
condition.necessity: Moving the requested source mug, rather than introducing or repositioning a different mug, is necessary to fulfill the requested relative placement.
condition.zero_when: There is evidence that the source blue mug was not displaced toward the right of the headphones. A different mug on the right does not count. If identity or displacement cannot be judged from the blur, candidate mugs, and other continuity cues, the evidence is insufficient rather than established zero fulfillment.
condition.half_when: The source mug is not shown to have reached the right of the headphones, but concrete visual evidence supports that this same mug was displaced toward them; a specific remaining positional deficiency is visible. Assess the blue blurred form’s shape, extent, and spatial relation to the source location, headphones, and candidate mugs alongside continuity cues. Do not treat blur, color, or scene change alone as proof when the source mug’s displacement remains indeterminate.
condition.full_when: The source blue mug is visibly identifiable as the same mug and is positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image.
